capabilities: render nested lists as visual tier lists
rank items manually into customizable tiers
display item covers from images or frontmatter
supplement lists with notes from Dataview queries
edit items via context menus and modal windows
extras: Reading View offers richer item editing (colors, transformations) than Editing View; the tier-render trigger tag is configurable in settings.
intentEvidence: Unlike tools like Dataview, where sorting often requires defining custom variables, the Tier List plugin enables manual sorting of list items.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in visual ranking tool; sorting notes usually means numeric ratings or query-based ordering rather than manual placement.

relations.evidence: This plugin integrates with Dataview, allowing you to supplement your tier lists with missing notes

summary: Renders nested Markdown lists as visual tier lists so you can manually rank notes into tiers, with image covers and Dataview query support.
